summary: Plan supplier mapping, plot records and inclusive due diligence for commodity exports. Explore the practical course and review the outline.
lede: Forest-risk traceability and due diligence connect commodity lots, suppliers and plot records to usable sourcing evidence. For procurement, sustainability and traceability teams, the training develops practical ways to map supply-chain roles, assess plot and legality records, and plan supplier engagement that includes smallholders. It also covers identifying data gaps and organizing action plans around sourcing risk and data readiness.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coordinate forest-risk sourcing evidence across exporters, traders, cooperatives, suppliers and public-sector or development programmes. It is designed for people who need to make traceability workable across real supplier networks, including smallholder production.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commodity procurement, sustainability, traceability or supplier records is useful. No programming is required. Participants should be ready to work with supply-chain examples and basic spreadsheet information.
